kev_metadata.notes: This vulnerability affects a common open-source component, third-party library, or a protocol used by different products. For more information, please see: https://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/torvalds/linux.git/commit?id=722d94847de2; https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2022-0185
kev_metadata.requiredAction: Apply updates per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if updates are unavailable.
kev_metadata.shortDescription: Linux kernel contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the legacy_parse_param function in the Filesystem Context functionality. This allows an attacker to open a filesystem that does not support the Filesystem Context API and ultimately escalate privileges.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability

title: Linux Kernel Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability

kev_metadata.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_metadata.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and other Apple products contain a use-after-free vulnerability in WebKit. Processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to memory corruption. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Use-After-Free WebKit Vulnerability

title: Apple Multiple Products Use-After-Free WebKit Vulnerability
